name: row-reader-poc
description: Binary row serialization (Rust/WASM) vs JSON benchmark POC for Zero IVM.

scripts.build:wasm:node: pnpm run build:wasm:cargo && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/row_wasm.wasm --out-dir pkg-node --target nodejs && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > pkg-node/package.json
scripts.build:wasm:web: pnpm run build:wasm:cargo && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/row_wasm.wasm --out-dir pkg-web --target web
scripts.build:wasm: pnpm run build:wasm:node && pnpm run build:wasm:web
